name: rhea
description: Local-dev helper only. frontend/ and backend/ deploy as two services in one Railway project — see DEPLOY.md.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev:https"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
